title: elymus racemosus var. sabulosus
intro: Elymus racemosus var. sabulosus, commonly known as sand lovegrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elymus racemosus var. sabulosus include soothing irritated skin, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
